purpose: Wholly-new confirmation of the simplest falsifiable sequential optional-compute policy suggested by the preregistered 916xxx/917xxx development audit. This is deliberately separate from the frozen v2 static selector and does not modify/refit it.
selection_timing: The exact seed lists, index97 checkpoint, gap threshold 47, support gate and success rule are frozen here before any 918xxx/919xxx outcome is evaluated. Repository search before creation found no own-role occurrence of exact seeds 918000 or 919000.
search_contract: Exactly the frozen local-search substrate used by coalition_seeded_stage_option_value_dev_v0: verified natural+RCM incumbent; independent seeded challenger; relocation move-one-variable neighborhood; candidate width <= current_width+1; complete legal neighborhood before strict improvement acceptance; at most two accepted moves; every challenger BDD candidate compilation charged; cross-order Hamming-rank oracle and endpoint-local exhaustive truth oracle.
frozen_v1_scope: Apply the sequential probe only when frozen v1 reaches challenger index65, the challenger remains active, no verified challenger endpoint has yet beaten the retained incumbent, and best_gap65 > 11. If v1 already continues or has a certificate, follow frozen v1 unchanged; those rows do not establish incremental value of this probe.

probe_policy.exact_rule: For each v1-stop state, continue the existing seeded challenger from index66 through min(index97, challenger exhaustion). The probe cost is every additional candidate compilation actually executed. If exhausted, merge any verified improvement and stop. Otherwise compute best_gap97 = best verified challenger live nodes through index97 minus retained incumbent live nodes. Buy the entire remaining challenger tail iff best_gap97 <= 47; otherwise stop. Any verified improvement witnessed during probing or continuation is merged only if better than the retained incumbent.
probe_policy.origin: Checkpoint97 and threshold47 were selected post-outcome on the 916xxx/917xxx development batch where the rule recovered all 81 available gain at approximately 34.06% of exhaustive stop-tail compute. Those development outcomes are now frozen and are not confirmation evidence.
probe_policy.no_adaptation: Do not alter index97, threshold47, graph families, seed list, cost accounting or success rule after any 918xxx/919xxx outcome is opened.

audit: For evaluation only, exhaustively finish every v1-stop challenger tail regardless of deployed probe decision so available gain and false negatives are observable. Audit-only continuation after a deployed stop is excluded from deployed compute. Retained-incumbent merge prevents audit or probe from worsening endpoint quality.
primary_metrics: available incremental verified gain in v1-stop rows
probe-policy recovered incremental gain and gain-weighted recall
deployed post-index65 probe+selected-tail compilations / exhaustive audited stop-tail compilations
family-specific gain/recall/compute, especially erdos and watts
first incumbent-certificate checkpoint/stage for missed positives
per-case no-harm relative to frozen v1

confirmation_support_gate.if_failed: INCONCLUSIVE_LOW_POSITIVE_SUPPORT; do not retune and reuse this split as confirmation.

required: zero per-case quality harm versus frozen v1 under retained-incumbent merge
deployed post-index65 probe+selected-tail compilations <= 0.45 of exhaustive audited stop-tail compilations
success_rule.rationale: Development-only post-hoc rule achieved 1.0 gain recall at about 0.3406 exhaustive tail compute. Confirmation permits material slack but must retain a meaningful quality/compute Pareto improvement over exhaustive continuation.

scope: Synthetic positive-monotone graph 2-CNF ROBDD ordering only. A positive result would confirm this sequential allocation rule only on the specified synthetic distribution, not theorem proving.
